values.meaning: damage cap against monsters and structures

mechanics.claim: Rell's next basic attack or Shattering Strike within 5 seconds creates an explosion around the target dealing the bonus magic damage.
mechanics.quote: Additionally, '''Rell's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Shattering Strike|Rell}}'' within 5 seconds creates an explosion around {{tt|the target|See Notes}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The percent-health damage cap only applies against monsters and structures, not champions.
If Shattering Strike hits multiple enemies, the explosion is centered on the unit with the lowest Spawn ID.
mechanics.quote: If ''{{ai|Shattering Strike|Rell}}'' hits more than one enemy, the ''Full Tilt'' explosion will be centered around the unit with the lowest {{tt|Spawn ID|among enemy champions, this would also be the enemy first pick in Blind Pick mode}}.
